prompt: Save this for later reading and also to readwise: https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-03-15/sec-enforcement-update

assertions.name: no_metadata_extraction
assertions.description: Agent does NOT try to extract metadata or rename — it's a URL, not a file

assertions.name: daily_note_markdown_link
assertions.description: Daily note uses markdown link format [Title](URL), not wiki-link

assertions.name: readwise_save
assertions.description: Agent saves URL to Readwise Reader with appropriate tag

assertions.name: daily_note_under_reading
assertions.description: Daily note entry is inserted under # Reading heading
